title: Designing Cellular Manufacturing Systems in the Presence of Alternative Process Plans
abstract: arXiv:2411.15361v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the design of cellular manufacturing systems (CMS), numerous technological and managerial decisions must be made at both the design and operational stages. The first step in designing a CMS involves grouping parts and machines. In this paper, four integer programming formulations are presented for grouping parts and machines in a CMS at both the design and operational levels for a generalised grouping problem, where each part has more than one process plan and each operation of a process plan can be performed on more than one machine. These four integer programming formulations have the ability to simultaneously optimise cell formation and operational routing decisions within a unified framework, whereas prior models often treat these as sequential or independent stages. translated_title: 存在替代工艺方案时的单元制造系统设计
translated_abstract: 在单元制造系统（CMS）的设计中，必须在设计和运营阶段做出众多技术和管理决策。设计CMS的第一步涉及将零件和机器分组。本文针对一个广义分组问题，提出了四种整数规划模型，用于在设计和运营层面同时对CMS中的零件和机器进行分组，其中每个零件具有多个工艺方案，且每个工艺方案的每道操作可在多台机器上执行。这四种整数规划模型能够在统一框架内同时优化单元形成和运营路径决策，而先前的模型通常将这些视为顺序或独立阶段。通过将机器灵活性和替代工艺方案直接纳入数学目标，该方法确保了更全局优化的配置。
tldr: 本文提出了四种整数规划模型，首次在统一框架内同时优化单元制造系统中的单元形成和运营路径决策，并直接整合机器灵活性和替代工艺方案，以实现更全局优化的配置。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes four integer programming formulations that simultaneously optimize cell formation and operational routing decisions within a unified framework, directly integrating machine flexibility and alternative process plans for a more globally optimal configuration in cellular manufacturing systems.
